description: Annual Traffic Collisions Data is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. This dataset shows yearly data concerning traffic collisions in Leicester. The data is updated yearly. This dataset is also part of a dashboard that has been created showing a range of transport related data. The dashboard can be viewed here. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are Transport, traffic, accidents. The portal shows 8 records. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
